# harvester_kubeovn_subnet (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harvester_kubeovn_subnet" "example" {
  name = "ovn-default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A unique name

### Read-Only

- `allow_subnets` (List of String) CIDRs allowed to reach a private subnet.
- `cidr_block` (String) CIDR of the subnet. A dual-stack subnet takes an IPv4 and an IPv6 CIDR separated by a comma.
- `description` (String) Any text you want that better describes this resource
- `dhcp_v4_options` (String) DHCPv4 options, for example "lease_time=3600,router=10.0.0.1,server_id=169.254.0.254,server_mac=00:00:00:2E:2F:B8".
- `enable_dhcp` (Boolean) Answer DHCP requests of the VMs on the subnet.
- `enable_lb` (Boolean) Apply the Kubernetes services load balancing on the subnet.
- `exclude_ips` (Set of String) IP addresses or ranges ("10.0.0.10..10.0.0.20") kept out of the subnet IPAM pool. kube-ovn always reserves the gateway and merges overlapping ranges, and the planned value does the same.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway address, one per IP family separated by a comma. kube-ovn uses the first address of cidr_block when it is omitted.
- `gateway_node` (String) Nodes that carry the outgoing traffic of a centralized subnet, separated by commas.
- `gateway_type` (String) Outgoing traffic leaves through every node (distributed) or through gateway_node (centralized).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `message` (String)
- `namespaces` (List of String) Namespaces bound to the subnet.
- `nat_outgoing` (Boolean) Masquerade the traffic that leaves the subnet.
- `network_provider` (String) Provider of the network attachment definition of the overlay network, in the form <nad name>.<nad namespace>.ovn. Harvester refuses a subnet without it.
- `private` (Boolean) Only accept traffic from the subnet itself and from allow_subnets.
- `protocol` (String) IP family of the subnet. kube-ovn derives it from cidr_block and overwrites any other value, so it is computed when omitted.
- `state` (String)
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `v4_available_ips` (Number) Number of IPv4 addresses still free.
- `v4_using_ips` (Number) Number of IPv4 addresses in use.
- `vlan` (String) Name of the kube-ovn VLAN of an underlay subnet.
- `vpc` (String) Name of the VPC the subnet belongs to.
